svg.text: Native Lettuce two-tier caches, shared config, Redis tracking invalidation, and the JCache bridge boundary.

g.text: front hit -> return; miss -> Redis GET + fill
close() shuts listener, connection, front cache
JCache bridge: jcache(), suspendJCache(), nearJCache(), suspendNearJCache()
LettuceJCache stores entries in Redis hash fields
NearJCache/SuspendNearJCache wrap the shared cache-core two-tier JCache types
